authority: docs/readiness/2026-09-16-slurp-next-stage-owner-decisions-v1.md owner decisions 99 (2026-09-22) and 107 (2026-09-23); roster shape from docs/readiness/2026-09-19-slurp-test-split-one-read-protocol-v1-draft.md section 2
design: The COMPLETE official SLURP test split: every sentence record, every recording, both microphone channels. No subsampling, no stratified draw, no filtering, no reserve. Read exactly once, at the end of Stage 3, under the owner allowance of decision 108; the roster itself authorises nothing.

measurement.decoder: soundfile header probe for duration and rate; bytes hashed with SHA-256. No audio sample is decoded, ffmpeg is absent by design and no media byte is rewritten.

media_identity: Per-row audio_sha256, media_relpath, bytes and sample rate live in the runtime view configs/dataset/slurp-speech-native-test-full.json and in the D1 supplement docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-slurp-test-full.json; this receipt is the identity statement and carries durations only.
one_read_rule: ONE complete read, registered before contact, scored once as one complete manifest job. There is no smoke, pilot, preview or sanity batch on these rows, no second configuration, no re-score and no re-registration. The preparations (packets, speech query vectors) are label-free encoder passes and do not consume the split's answer surface, but they carry the same machine role and the same owner allowance.
seed_note: seed 20260923 is recorded because the receipt schema carries one; a take-all freeze draws nothing, so the value cannot affect the frozen id set
selection_rule: the complete split, id-sorted; no sampling. core.roster.freeze_roster is given a per-stratum quota equal to each stratum's own capacity, so every candidate is selected and the seed never changes the outcome.
split_identity_hash_basis: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted carrier-prefixed 'slurp/<sample_id>' ids -- the core.roster / data.splits convention, which is what an ExecutionPlan declares

split_identity_receipt.basis: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted BARE sample ids -- the rails.knowledge_build.freeze_slurp_split_identity convention, which is NOT the carrier-prefixed core.roster/data.splits convention the roster's own split_identity_hash uses

strata_definition: MICROPHONE CHANNEL only: 'headset' is the '-headset' recording-id suffix, 'far-field' is everything else. Scenario is a GOLD field of the test split and is deliberately not used as a stratum here, so the protocol draft's section 2.2 per-scenario breakdown is NOT part of this receipt.
